fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (24x on ~$9.90 NTM non-GAAP EPS as of Sep-2027 = $238), EV/NTM sales (11.5x on ~$4.0B + ~$1.8B net cash = $240) and a DCF ($190), weighted 45/25/30 -> ~$224 per share on ~199M diluted shares.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sep-2027 ~$9.90 (~0.7 x FY28 $8.90 + ~0.3 x FY29 $11.80, back-loaded). FY28 $8.90 = revenue $3.65B (+46%) x ~48.5% non-GAAP net margin / ~199M shares, a ~8% haircut to $9.63-9.70 consensus for concentration and Marvell pricing. Multiple 24x, down from ~33x FY27 today, as growth slows toward ~30%.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue at Sep-2027 ~$4.0B (0.7 x FY28 $3.65B + 0.3 x FY29 $4.7B) x 11.5x EV/sales = $46B EV, + ~$1.8B net cash (cut from $2.0B: $764M today after DustPhotonics and weak Q1 OCF of $90M), / 199M diluted shares

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: Valuation date Sep-2027. FY28 revenue base $3.65B (was $3.4B), then growth of 30/22/16/12/9% for FY29-FY33. FCF margin 38% (vs ~49% non-GAAP net margin, less working capital and inventory build). WACC 11% (high beta, concentrated customers), terminal growth 4%. EV ~$36.0B + $1.8B net cash, / 199M shares.

bear.story: AI capex digestion, or a lost or dual-sourced socket at the top customer (Amazon Trainium; one direct customer is 43% of revenue and 57% of receivables). Marvell 1.6T AECs, priced 15-20% below Credo, take share. The H2 FY27 ramp (~23% q/q) misses and FY28 growth falls to ~20%. The multiple compresses to ~15x on ~$7.5 NTM EPS, a revisit of and break below the $150 September low.

base.story: FY27 revenue of ~$2.5B is delivered. FY28 grows ~45% to ~$3.65B ('outsized growth again', with ALC, OmniConnect and first DustPhotonics NPO revenue) at ~68% non-GAAP GM. Optics above $600M diversifies revenue away from AECs. The stock de-rates to ~24x NTM EPS of ~$9.9, a modest gain.

bull.story: Trn3 plus hyperscaler and neocloud ramps, ALCs and scale-up optics drive FY28 revenue above $4.2B and NTM EPS to ~$12.5. The market pays ~30x and the stock clears its June-2026 high of $308.

thesis_break_reason: The verified post-earnings low was a $150.09 close on 2026-09-14. That was a sentiment-only selloff after a beat and raise. $125 is ~17% below it and ~13x FY28 consensus EPS (~$9.65). A close there would most likely mean a fundamental break rather than ordinary 90%+ volatility: a top-2 customer pause or dual-source (e.g. Marvell 1.6T AECs at Amazon), a failed H2 FY27 ramp or guide cut, or a hyperscaler capex cut.

Whether H2 FY27 delivers ~$1.47B (~23% q/q) to meet the >85% guide

reasoning: Round 2 revision. The supervisor's fact-checks, which I verified, changed three inputs. (1) FY28 revenue growth: my round-1 $3.4B (+35%) path did not fit my own near-consensus EPS of $9.00, which implied a ~52% net margin. Management said it expects 'outsized growth again for another year' in FY28 (Motley Fool transcript), and FY28 EPS consensus has risen to ~$9.63-9.70 (24/7 Wall St: from $8.69 90 days ago, 14 up-revisions). I raised base FY28 revenue to $3.65B (+46%) but kept EPS at ~$8.90, still below consensus, because I still discount concentration (a 43% direct customer) and Marvell 1.6T AEC pricing. I did not go all the way to the supervisor's $3.8-3.9B because no quantitative guide exists and competitive pricing pressure is real. (2) Net cash: I cut it to ~$1.8B by Sep-2027. Cash is $764M after DustPhotonics, and Q1 OCF was only $90.2M on the inventory build, which I confirmed. (3) The September low was $150.09, not $167-170. That confirms a deeper sentiment drawdown than I had assumed and supports keeping a fat left tail. Methods: P/E $238 (from $235), EV/sales $240 (from $227; higher NTM revenue and 11.5x vs 12x, less net cash), DCF $190 (from $175; higher revenue base and 38% FCF margin vs 36%, a margin I had understated against a ~49% non-GAAP net margin). The blend rises to ~$224 from $215. Distribution: median ~$222 (from ~$214) and sigma ~0.6, which is below the 96% trailing realized vol but far above large-cap base rates. I kept the left tail near round 1, P(<$127) ~19%, because concentration is worse than I had stated. Mid strikes rise ~2-3 points. The right tail is only slightly higher because peer multiples are compressing. Scenarios: $115/$240/$380 at 25/50/25, probability-weighted ~$244, a mean above the median consistent with a lognormal-like skew. As of 2026-09-26 the stock closed at $210.12 (Trefis) with analyst targets averaging $280 (19 analysts, range $185-350). I treat those targets as evidence, not the answer. No option data or priors consulted. Research was ~6 follow-up searches/fetches on top of round 1.
